$comment: Licences allowed for npm packages (SPDX expressions as package-lock.json records them). 'shipped' is for packages the client or the rooms Worker bundles (production dependencies); 'tools' adds what build, test and dev tooling may use, which is never shipped. Read by tools/ci/check-credits.mjs. Anything new needs a read of the licence first. MPL-2.0: lightningcss, Vite's CSS minifier, used unmodified. LGPL-3.0-or-later: libvips in sharp's optional prebuilt binaries, pulled in by Wrangler's local runtime and dynamically linked.
